name: Packages Mall
assumptions: No published height: main walls 18.5 m, drum 20 m and blade tips 29 m are scaled from photo wiki5 with the pink columns taken as 5 m from a person in ft_b.
Cladding #CFC9BD is read from daylight photos; the dossier #928D89 is a dusk thumbnail sample and looked too dark.
Roof plan, solar panels and blades traced by hand from Esri satellite at about 0.5 m per pixel; satellite lean may shift them 2 to 4 m.
Which entrance wiki5 shows is inferred: the south-west pair, because the long wall runs off to the viewer's left there.
North entrance drum and blades use the south-west elevation; only its roof plan was seen.
Each blade rises to one tip at the point traced furthest out; the tip height and the fold of the underside are simplified from one low photo.
One pale post per blade; the V strut in the pre-construction render was not confirmed as built.
Drum sagitta 4 m and depth are estimates; the narrow glazed reveal beside the drum in wiki5 is omitted.
Pink V columns are three pairs per drum, read from wiki5 and ft_b; exact count not confirmed.
East hall roof is at the same height as the main roof: no photo of that side, plainest form.
South, east and north service elevations were not photographed and are plain cladding over the same dark band.
The dark ground band is drawn as continuous shopfront at 5 m; the car park wall in ft_main shows it, other sides are assumed.
Wall corners at OSM nodes 18 to 20 are rounded by up to 22 m to give the single curve seen on the satellite.
Billboards are blank panels at estimated positions; brand signs are left off because they change. The blue one's place along the wall is a guess.
Service annexes outside the OSM ring on the south side, the forecourt tree sculpture, planters and the car park are not modelled.
